### 4. JS / NT8 Rule Constraints

| Rule ID | Description | Application |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| JS-021 | No `lock()` anywhere | No lock in any new/modified method — use existing ConcurrentBag iterate pattern |
| JS-001 | No throw in hot path | `acc.Change()` calls wrapped in try/catch that logs via `StatusUpdate` |
| JS-002 | No `return null` | All new helpers return `bool` or `void`; no null returns |
| NT8-026 | `order.TrailPrice > 0` = trailing stop | `IsTrailingStop` uses this exact predicate (confirmed fact) |
| NT8-007 | `CreateOrder` arg 12 = `(CustomOrder)null` | T1 does NOT use `CreateOrder` — pure `acc.Change()` path only |
| CYC <= 8 | All methods max 8 branches | `MoveStopToBreakEven`=6, `HandleBracketChange`=6, `SyncFollowerBracket`=5, `IsStopAlreadyAtBe`=2, `IsTrailingStop`=1 |
| ASCII-only | No Unicode in string literals | "trailing skip" is ASCII |
| No DateTime.Now | Use `DateTime.UtcNow` if needed | T1 has no time logging — not applicable |

### 4. JS / NT8 Rule Constraints

| Rule ID | Description | Application |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| JS-021 | No `lock()` | `Interlocked.CompareExchange` for disarm race instead of lock |
| JS-033 | No `async void` (non-event-handler) | `FlashBeFired` is `async void` — explicitly allowed (UI event handler via `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync`) |
| NT8-003 | No `volatile double` | `_pendingBeBufferTicks` is `volatile int` (correct); `_pendingBeAccount`/`_pendingBeInstrument` are plain refs (not volatile) — protected by `_pendingBeState` volatile release fence |
| THREAD | All UI updates from bg thread via Dispatcher | `OnPendingBeFiredDispatch` marshals to UI via `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync`; `OnPendingBeAccountUpdate` does NOT touch any UI directly |
| CYC <= 8 | All methods max 8 branches | `ArmPendingBe`=4, `DisarmPendingBe`=3, `OnPendingBeAccountUpdate`=5, `OnBEArmClick`=3, `UpdateBEArmVisuals`=2, `FlashBeFired`=2, `BuildBeArmRow`=1, `OnPendingBeFiredDispatch`=1 |
| ASCII-only | No Unicode in literals | "Arm BE" is ASCII |
| No hex colors | Use existing brush statics | `BrushCaution`, `BrushActive`, `BrushInactive` (not hardcoded hex) |

### 4. JS / NT8 Rule Constraints

| Rule ID | Description | Application |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| JS-021 | No `lock()` | No lock anywhere — `TightenStop` reads from `ConcurrentBag` iterate pattern |
| JS-001 | No throw in hot path | `TightenOneStop` wraps `acc.Cancel`/`acc.Change`/`acc.CreateOrder` in try/catch |
| NT8-007 | `CreateOrder` arg 12 = `(CustomOrder)null` | `TightenOneStop` trailing-stop cancel+replace uses `(NinjaTrader.Cbi.CustomOrder)null` |
| PTT- prefix | All `CreateOrder` signal names start with `"PTT-"` | Signal name: `"PTT-Tighten-Stop"` |
| NT8 Math.Clamp ban | .NET 4.8 has no `Math.Clamp` | Use `Math.Max(1, Math.Min(500, ticks))` |
| NT8-001 | No `{ get; init; }` | `TightenTicks` is a `readonly int` field on readonly struct (not init-only property) |
| XML backward compat | Old XML without `TightenTicks` defaults to 0 | `DtoToRule` converts: `dto.TightenTicks > 0 ? dto.TightenTicks : 5` |
| CYC <= 8 | All methods max 8 branches | `TightenStop`=5, `TightenOneStop`=4, `OnTightenStop`=3, `OnRuleTightenStop`=4 |
| ASCII-only | No Unicode | `"PTT-Tighten-Stop"`, `"tks"`, `"~"` are all ASCII |

### 4. JS / NT8 Rule Constraints

| Rule ID | Description | Application |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| JS-021 | No `lock()` | No lock in any new/modified method |
| JS-001 | No throw in hot path | `StartAtrEngine` attachment steps wrapped in try/catch with `StatusUpdate` |
| THREAD | All UI updates via Dispatcher | `UpdateAtrOverlay` always uses `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync`; `AtrUpdated` callback fires on bar-close thread |
| ASCII-only | No Unicode in literals | `"ATR=-.-- pts -> stopTicks=-- -> qty=--"`, `"ATR={0:F2} pts -> stopTicks={1} -> qty={2}"` are ASCII |
| No FontFamily | Prohibited | `_atrOverlayLabel` has no FontFamily property set |
| No hex colors | Use system brushes or existing statics | `Border` uses no hardcoded hex colors; uses `BorderBrush` default or existing `BrushInactive` |
| No DateTime.Now | N/A | T4 has no time logging |
| CYC <= 8 | All methods max 8 branches | `StartAtrEngine`=4, `BuildAtrOverlayRow`=1, `UpdateAtrOverlay`=2, `ResolveChartTraderPanel`<=3 |
| NT8 knowledge update | Per AGENTS.md | After T4 executes, record which attachment path succeeded in `docs/standards/NT8_ADDON_KNOWLEDGE.md` |
